title: Find p from Vertical Asymptote
text:
The vertical asymptote is at $x = -1$.

For $y = \frac{a}{x - p} + q$, the vertical asymptote is $x = p$.

Therefore, $p = -1$.

title: Find q from Horizontal Asymptote
text:
The horizontal asymptote is at $y = 3$.

For $y = \frac{a}{x - p} + q$, the horizontal asymptote is $y = q$.

Therefore, $q = 3$.

title: State p and q
text:
From the asymptotes:
- $p = -1$ (from vertical asymptote $x = -1$)
- $q = 3$ (from horizontal asymptote $y = 3$)
